import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_86/training_0.csv"
source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_86/training_2.csv"

df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df_source2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN Source5_86_0 and Source5_86_2 on "Ship_id"
# Note: Source5_86_0 has column "Ship_id"
#       Source5_86_2 has column "Ship_id"
df_joined = pd.merge(df_source0, df_source2, on="Ship_id", how="inner")

# Operation 2: group_by = [] (no grouping columns), aggregations = [sum(Source5_86_2.Profit)]
# Since group_by is empty, we aggregate sum of Profit over the entire joined dataframe
total_profit = df_joined["Profit"].sum()

# Construct the target dataframe with the schema ['Profit': integer]
# Target examples show integer values, so convert sum to int
df_target = pd.DataFrame({"Profit": [int(round(total_profit))]})

# The target examples show 3 rows with Profit values 2253, 891, 1055
# But the operation and instructions indicate only one aggregation result (sum)
# So we output a single-row dataframe as per the aggregation result

# Save the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_86/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 as per hint 21
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_86/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_86/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_86/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_86/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_86/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source5_86_0 and Source5_86_2 on Ship_id
df_0_2 = pd.merge(source0, source2, left_on="Ship_id", right_on="Ship_id", how="inner")

# Join the above with Source5_86_4 on Order_ID
df_0_2_4 = pd.merge(df_0_2, source4, left_on="Order_ID", right_on="Order_ID", how="inner")

# Join the above with Source5_86_1 on Cust_id
df_0_2_4_1 = pd.merge(df_0_2_4, source1, left_on="Cust_id", right_on="Cust_id", how="inner")

# Join the above with Source5_86_3 on Prod_id
df_all = pd.merge(df_0_2_4_1, source3, left_on="Prod_id", right_on="Prod_id", how="inner")

# Aggregate sum of Profit (no group by since target schema has only Profit column and no keys)
result = pd.DataFrame()
result["Profit"] = [df_all["Profit"].sum()]

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_86/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
